name: SPT Item Creator
teaser: This mod simplifies SPT item creation and enables efficient expansion through interface encapsulation and comprehensive documentation.
description:
English

The mod aims to simplify the process of adding new items in SPT by encapsulating item creation interfaces, and provides comprehensive documentation that systematically organizes data resources and explains the function of various properties and fields. The accompanying Wiki offers complete API references and item creation guides, helping developers and players use the mod more efficiently and rapidly expand SPT’s item database.

Tag Explanation:
The mod uses semantic versioning (x.x.x). The Wiki (available as a separate download from the mod plugin) is also released with semantic versions but is uniquely identified by Wiki Tags. A Wiki tag follows the format Wiki_Year_Month_Day_Hour_Minute and is used consistently for labeling and linking within the local Wiki documentation.

Download Instructions:
Starting from version v0.1.0, to reduce package size, the default download link only provides the mod itself. The Wiki is no longer bundled with the mod.

  • If you need only the mod, download it directly from this page.
  • If you want to download or update the Wiki, get it separately from the mod plugin page.

After extracting the mod, you will find one folder:

  • SPT/user/mods/SptItemCreator: The main mod

New Cache System (v0.1.0+):

  • Output directory: [Game Root]\SPT\user\mods\SptItemCreator\StatsCache
  • Contents: Based on the entire SPT database, the mod generates a categorized list for each type, including all property names and all values that have appeared.
  • Purpose: Serves as a reference when creating new items, and provides a foundation for creating scripts to calculate frequencies, value distributions, averages, etc.

How to Use the Wiki:

  1. (Optional) Move the Wiki folder to any location you prefer — except inside any SPT 4.0 mod folder.
  2. Navigate into the Wiki folder.
  3. Double-click index.html.
  4. Starting from Wiki_26_02_02_18_20, the Wiki supports both Chinese and English bilingual content. You can switch between languages directly within the Wiki interface.

Note:
Since the mod and Wiki are now distributed separately (starting from v0.1.0), the server warning about “No Assemblies found” mentioned in previous versions no longer occurs. You can safely place the Wiki folder anywhere outside the SPT mods directory.

中文

本模组旨在通过封装物品创建接口，简化在SPT中新增物品的流程，并提供详尽的文档说明，系统整理各项数据资源与属性字段的作用。配套Wiki提供了完整的模组接口文档与物品创建指南，帮助开发者和玩家更高效地使用本模组，快速扩展SPT中的物品内容。

标签说明：
模组以语义化版本（x.x.x）计算版本。Wiki（可在模组插件页面单独下载）虽也使用语义化版本发布，但实际使用Wiki标签来标记唯一的版本。Wiki标签由“Wiki_年_月_日_时_分”组成，并在本地Wiki文档中完全以此格式进行标记与链接。

下载说明：
从 v0.1.0 版本开始，为降低文件尺寸，默认下载链接仅提供模组本体，不再打包 Wiki。

  • 若仅需模组本体，直接在本页面下载即可。
  • 若需下载或更新 Wiki，可在本模组的插件页面单独获取。

解压模组后，仅包含以下文件夹：

  • SPT/user/mods/SptItemCreator：模组本体

新缓存系统（v0.1.0+）：

  • 输出目录： 游戏根目录\SPT\user\mods\SptItemCreator\StatsCache
  • 内容： 模组根据当前 SPT 的所有数据库，整理的一份按照类型分类好的、每个类型有的属性名称与所有出现过的值的列表
  • 用处： 创建新物品时的参考；制作脚本统计频数、数值分布、均值等的基础

Wiki 使用方式：

  1. （可选）将 Wiki 文件夹移动到任意你喜欢的位置（切勿放入任何 SPT 4.0 模组文件夹内）
  2. 进入 Wiki 文件夹
  3. 双击打开 index.html
  4. 从 Wiki_26_02_02_18_20 版本开始，Wiki 已支持中英文双语内容，可在 Wiki 界面内直接切换语言阅读。

说明：
由于新版本（v0.1.0 起）模组与 Wiki 已分开分发，此前版本中提到的“服务端提示 No Assemblies found 警告”的问题已不复存在。您只需将 Wiki 文件夹放置在 SPT 模组目录外的任意位置即可正常使用。

versions.description:
English

Fixes

  • Populated FleaPriceRoubles, HandbookPriceRoubles, HandbookParentId field mappings during NewItem object initialization (#9)
  • Fixed validation logic defects for HandbookParentId in CreateItemFromClone and CreateNewItem, removed incorrect required checks (#10, #11, #12)
  • Fixed redundant parameter issue in AddItemToAssort method calls

Refactoring & Optimization

  • Removed legacy AbstractNewItem abstract base class and its subclasses (NewItemCommon, NewItemAmmo, NewItemDrinkOrFood, NewItemMedical)
  • Unified NewItem architecture: All item types now share the NewItem class, with property application determined by the assigned AbstractInfo instance
  • Marked AmmoInfo class as [Obsolete], planned for refactoring in a future version
  • Marked BaseInfo.IsHadInit property as [Obsolete], to be removed after version 0.2.0
  • Added NewItemExtensions extension class, implementing ToStringWithStatus() and ToIdNameString() methods for unified log formatting output
  • Removed unused dependency injections (ISptLogger, DatabaseService) from DataLoader constructor
  • Added [UsedImplicitly] attribute to INewItem.PropertyOverride property to eliminate warnings

Data Format Changes

  • Removed the $type field from item templates (backward compatible reading retained)
  • Type mechanism clarification: Item properties are determined by the actually assigned Info fields, independent of baseInfo.type
  • Data files now support JSONC comments (single-line // and multi-line /* */), added StripJsoncComments method to DataLoader with state machine parsing logic

New Features

  • Support for Chinese rarity keys (Common, Rare, Super Rare, Nonexistent)
  • Support for Chinese item sound keys
  • Support for ammunition type item validation

Configuration Updates

  • Added cacheInitialized configuration option to control cache initialization skipping and state persistence
  • Added alwaysUpdateCache configuration option to force cache updates
  • Added requiredItemIds configuration option to validate existence and enabled status of required items
  • See Mod Configuration documentation for details

Validation System

  • Built a unified validator system, implementing IValidator interface and chaining calls
  • Added BaseInfoValidator: validates required fields, MongoId format, type validity
  • Added AttributeInfoValidator: validates positive integer dimensions, rarity, sound type
  • Added BuffsInfoValidator: validates Buff effect configurations
  • Added MedicalInfoValidator, DrinkFoodInfoValidator, AmmoInfoValidator: respectively validate medical, food/drink, and ammunition configuration logic
  • Removed invalid negative weight validation logic
  • Enhanced error collector to carry item path information for easier problem localization

Architecture Optimization

  • Changed UpdateProperties and UpdateDatabaseService methods to protected, restricting external calls
  • Enhanced null validation logic for BaseInfo and BuffsInfo
  • Improved deserialization error logging, added complete exception stack traces
中文

修复问题

  • 补全 NewItem 对象初始化时的 FleaPriceRoubles、HandbookPriceRoubles、HandbookParentId 字段映射 (#9)
  • 修正 CreateItemFromClone 和 CreateNewItem 中的 HandbookParentId 验证逻辑缺陷，移除错误的必填检查 (#10, #11, #12)
  • 修正 AddItemToAssort 方法调用中冗余参数的问题

重构优化

  • 移除旧版 AbstractNewItem 抽象基类及其子类实现（NewItemCommon, NewItemAmmo, NewItemDrinkOrFood, NewItemMedical）
  • 统一 NewItem 架构：所有物品类型共用 NewItem 类，通过已赋值的 AbstractInfo 实例决定属性应用
  • 标记 AmmoInfo 类为 [Obsolete]，计划后续版本重构
  • 标记 BaseInfo.IsHadInit 属性为 [Obsolete]，将在 0.2.0 版本后移除
  • 新增 NewItemExtensions 扩展类，实现 ToStringWithStatus() 和 ToIdNameString() 方法，统一日志格式化输出
  • 清理 DataLoader 构造函数中未使用的依赖注入（ISptLogger、DatabaseService）
  • INewItem.PropertyOverride 属性添加 [UsedImplicitly] 特性以消除警告

数据格式变更

  • 移除物品模板中的 $type 字段（保留向后兼容读取）
  • 类型机制澄清：物品属性由实际赋值的 Info 字段决定，与 baseInfo.type 无关
  • 数据文件现支持 JSONC 注释（单行 // 和多行 /* */），DataLoader 增加 StripJsoncComments 方法及状态机解析逻辑

新功能

  • 支持中文稀有度键（普通、稀有、超级稀有、不存在）
  • 支持中文物品音效键
  • 支持弹药类型物品验证

配置更新

  • 新增 cacheInitialized 配置项，控制缓存初始化跳过及状态持久化
  • 新增 alwaysUpdateCache 配置项，强制更新缓存
  • 新增 requiredItemIds 配置项，验证必需物品存在性与启用状态
  • 详见模组配置文档

验证系统

  • 构建统一验证器系统，实现 IValidator 接口与链式调用
  • 新增 BaseInfoValidator：验证必需字段、MongoId 格式、类型合法性
  • 新增 AttributeInfoValidator：验证尺寸正整数、稀有度、音效类型
  • 新增 BuffsInfoValidator：验证 Buff 效果配置
  • 新增 MedicalInfoValidator、DrinkFoodInfoValidator、AmmoInfoValidator：分别验证医疗、饮食及弹药配置逻辑
  • 移除无效的负数重量校验逻辑
  • 增强错误收集器，支持携带物品路径信息以便定位问题

架构优化

  • 将 UpdateProperties 和 UpdateDatabaseService 方法改为 protected，限制外部调用
  • 增强 BaseInfo 和 BuffsInfo 的空值校验逻辑
  • 改进反序列化错误日志，添加完整异常堆栈信息

dependencies.name: SuntionCore
dependencies.teaser: Some commonly used methods extracted and optimized from the mods I've created, suitable for SPT server mods.

versions.description:
English

New Features

  • Hash Utility Class (HashUtil)

    • Added a universal hash calculation service supporting multiple algorithms: SHA1, SHA256, MD5, SHA384, SHA512 (default is SHA256)
    • Provides simple static methods: Hash(string text, HashAlgo hashAlgo) and Hash(byte[] data, HashAlgo hashAlgo)
    • Security Notice: Clearly distinguishes between recommended algorithms (SHA-2 series) and legacy algorithms (SHA1, MD5) with their applicable scenarios

  • Documentation Improvements

    • Updated Chinese and English README and API documentation, added HashUtil usage instructions

Optimizations and Adjustments

  • Centralized Module Constants Management
    • Centralized module name and logger instance management for improved code maintainability
  • Logging System Optimization
    • Simplified log access method, unified usage of SuntionCoreMod.Logger

Version Information

  • Module version updated to 1.2.0
  • Compatibility: No breaking changes, existing features remain unaffected

Developer Notes

  • When using the hash utility, please note: SHA1 and MD5 are only suitable for non-security-sensitive scenarios (such as file verification), it is recommended to use SHA256 and above algorithms
中文

新增功能

  • 哈希工具类 (HashUtil)

    • 新增通用哈希计算服务，支持 SHA1、SHA256、MD5、SHA384、SHA512 多种算法（默认 SHA256）
    • 提供简单易用的静态方法：Hash(string text, HashAlgo hashAlgo) 和 Hash(byte[] data, HashAlgo hashAlgo)
    • 安全提示：明确区分推荐算法（SHA-2 系列）与遗留算法（SHA1、MD5）的适用场景

  • 文档完善

    • 更新中英文 README 和 API 文档，新增 HashUtil 使用说明

优化与调整

  • 模组常量统一管理
    • 将模组名称和日志实例集中管理，提升代码可维护性
  • 日志系统优化
    • 简化日志获取方式，统一使用 SuntionCoreMod.Logger

版本信息

  • 模组版本号更新至 1.2.0
  • 兼容性：无破坏性变更，现有功能不受影响

开发者注意事项

  • 使用哈希工具时请注意：SHA1 和 MD5 仅适用于非安全敏感场景（如文件校验），推荐使用 SHA256 及以上算法

category.title: Tools
category.description: Various standalone tools and programs that aren't installed like normal mods

versions.description:
English

Minimum Wiki Version: Wiki_26_03_16_03_40

Changelog v0.1.0:

  • Completely removed all WebUI Razor files, including layouts, pages, and various information components. The original item creation and management interface is no longer accessible.
  • Removed the built-in WebUI service, deleting references related to HttpServer, WebApplicationBuilder, and MudBlazor.Services.
  • Removed outdated WebUI access guides and related operational instructions from the documentation, pending the completion of a refactored new UI or examination of alternative solutions.
  • Optimized the item validation process, unified parameter naming, and ensured property generation occurs only after successful validation to avoid redundant calculations.
  • Enhanced NewItemCommon validation logic: When BuffsInfo is provided but StimulatorBuffs is not, the data is silently cleaned, and the reason is logged.
  • Optimized the item loading log format, added dynamic display of item enable status, and improved the readability of debugging information.
  • Upgraded the project version number from 0.0.4 to 0.1.0, reflecting this major refactor.
  • Updated config.json, adding the default configuration ignoreTemplateFiles: true.
  • Removed the old JSON cache file structure (ParentIdCache.json, AmmoCache.json, etc.). Required statistical data will be regenerated on startup.

New Cache System:

  • Output directory: [Game Root]\SPT\user\mods\SptItemCreator\StatsCache
  • Contents: Based on the entire SPT database, the mod generates a categorized list for each type, including all property names and all values that have appeared.
  • Purpose: Serves as a reference when creating new items, and provides a foundation for creating scripts to calculate frequencies, value distributions, averages, etc.

Note on Compatibility: This version maintains full compatibility with all data files created since version v0.0.2. Your existing item definitions and configurations will continue to work without modification.

中文

最低 Wiki 版本：Wiki_26_03_16_03_40

更新日志 v0.1.0：

  • 完全移除所有 WebUI Razor 文件，包括布局、页面及各类信息组件，原有的物品创建和管理界面将不可访问。
  • 移除内置 WebUI 服务，删除 HttpServer、WebApplicationBuilder 及 MudBlazor.Services 相关引用。
  • 移除废弃的 WebUI 访问指南和文档中相关操作说明，等待后续重构完成的新 UI 或检查替代方案。
  • 优化物品验证流程，统一参数命名，将属性生成控制在验证通过后执行，避免重复计算。
  • 增强 NewItemCommon 验证逻辑：当提供 BuffsInfo 但未提供 StimulatorBuffs 时，静默清理该数据并记录原因。
  • 优化物品加载日志格式，增加物品启用状态的动态显示，提升调试信息可读性。
  • 升级项目版本号从 0.0.4 至 0.1.0，体现本次重大重构。
  • 更新 config.json，新增默认配置 ignoreTemplateFiles: true。
  • 移除原有的 JSON 缓存文件结构（ParentIdCache.json、AmmoCache.json 等），启动时会重新生成所需统计数据。

新缓存系统：

  • 输出目录： 游戏根目录\SPT\user\mods\SptItemCreator\StatsCache
  • 内容： 模组根据当前 SPT 的所有数据库，整理的一份按照类型分类好的、每个类型有的属性名称与所有出现过的值的列表
  • 用处： 创建新物品时的参考；制作脚本统计频数、数值分布、均值等的基础

兼容性说明： 本版本完全兼容自 v0.0.2 版本以来创建的所有数据文件。您现有的物品定义和配置文件无需修改即可继续使用。

versions.description:
English
  • Implemented the Settings Page (SettingPage), which resides permanently in the navigation bar and provides a WebUI configuration interface
  • Optimized DataLoader to support dynamically ignoring template files based on configuration
  • Moved all template files to the mod folder/data/模板-Template directory
  • Changed template filenames to bilingual (Chinese-English) to avoid mismatches between some translator results and the actual content
  • Adjusted the default maximum log file size from 10MB to 512KB (logs exceeding this size will be recreated when the mod starts)
中文
  • 实现设置页面(SettingPage)，常驻导航栏，提供WebUI配置界面
  • 优化DataLoader，支持根据配置动态忽略模板文件
  • 将所有模板文件移动至模组文件夹/data/模板-Template文件夹下
  • 将模板文件名改为中英双语, 避免部分翻译器结果与内容不对应
  • 默认日志文件最大大小从10MB调整至512KB(启动模组时超过这个大小会重新创建日志文件)

English

New Features:

  • Added a WebUI for creating items.
  • Introduced several new widgets for data visualization and editing:
    • BaseInfoWidget for modifying BaseInfo data.
    • AttributeInfoWidget for modifying AttributeInfo data.
    • DrinkFoodInfoWidget for modifying DrinkFoodInfo data.
    • MedicalInfoWidget for modifying MedicalInfo data.
    • BuffsInfoWidget for modifying BuffsInfo data.
    • PropertyOverrideWidget for viewing and modifying PropertyOverride data (simplified).
  • Added dedicated pages for creating:
    • Generic Items
    • Medical Items
    • Food & Drink Items
    • (Note: Ammunition creation is postponed due to additional related attributes.)

Improvements & Changes:

  • ParentId is now optional when a valid CloneId is assigned. An error will be thrown if the CloneId is invalid. (Updated the Wiki tutorial table accordingly.)
  • Added a new caching system. Data for ParentId and BackgroundColor is now cached from the SPT server. (Cache timestamp: OnLoadOrder.TraderCallbacks - 1)
  • Added a new BackgroundColor field to the AttributeInfo class.
中文

新增功能：

  • 新增用于创建物品的 Web 用户界面（WebUI）。
  • 新增多个控件，用于数据的可视化与编辑：
    • BaseInfoWidget：用于修改 BaseInfo 数据。
    • AttributeInfoWidget：用于修改 AttributeInfo 数据。
    • DrinkFoodInfoWidget：用于修改 DrinkFoodInfo 数据。
    • MedicalInfoWidget：用于修改 MedicalInfo 数据。
    • BuffsInfoWidget：用于修改 BuffsInfo 数据。
    • PropertyOverrideWidget：用于查看和修改 PropertyOverride 数据（简化版）。
  • 新增用于创建以下物品的专用页面：
    • 通用物品
    • 药品
    • 食物与饮品
    • （注：由于弹药涉及更多相关属性，其创建功能暂时搁置。）

改进与变更：

  • 当分配了有效的 CloneId 后，ParentId 变为可选字段。如果 CloneId 无效，系统将报错。（已同步更新 Wiki 教程中的相关表格。）
  • 新增缓存系统。现可从 SPT 服务器缓存 ParentId 和 BackgroundColor 数据。（缓存记录时间点：OnLoadOrder.TraderCallbacks - 1）
  • 在 AttributeInfo 类中新增了 BackgroundColor 字段。

English

Minimum Wiki Version: Wiki_26_01_23_19_00

  • Added new fields allowAll, canFilter, and cantFilter in baseInfo to control which containers can hold the item.
  • Added missing mod metadata URL information.
  • Removed the ineffective static property ShouldUpdateDatabaseService from AbstractInfo.
  • Added the ItemPath property to all AbstractInfo types for improved error reporting.
  • Improved code style during file deserialization.
  • Fixed logic errors in BuffsInfo related to null checks and error message output.
  • Fixed an issue in 测试-食物模板.sic.jsonc and 测试-饮品模板.sic.jsonc where buffsInfo.stimulatorBuffs was incorrectly assigned meaningless empty strings.

Known Issues

  • Container items created via cloning may fail to be stored in incompatible containers even when allowAll=true, behaving the same as the original cloned item. This issue can typically be resolved by clearing local cache, though in rare cases multiple clears may be required.
中文

最低Wiki版本： Wiki_26_01_23_19_00

  • baseInfo 新增 allowAll、canFilter、cantFilter 字段，用于控制本物品可存放的容器类型。
  • 补充模组元数据中的 url 信息。
  • 移除了 AbstractInfo 中未正确生效的静态属性 ShouldUpdateDatabaseService。
  • 为所有 AbstractInfo 类型新增 ItemPath 属性，便于错误信息定位与输出。
  • 优化了反序列化文件时的代码风格。
  • 修复了 BuffsInfo 中判断非空逻辑及错误信息输出的错误。
  • 修复了 测试-食物模板.sic.jsonc 和 测试-饮品模板.sic.jsonc 中 buffsInfo.stimulatorBuffs 被赋值为空字符串的问题。

已知问题

  • 通过克隆方式创建的容器类新物品，即使设置了 allowAll=true，仍可能无法放入不兼容的容器中（行为与被克隆物品一致）。此问题可通过清除本地缓存解决，极少数情况下需多次清理。

English
  • Implemented and encapsulated the item creation process for common items, medical supplies, ammunition, food, and beverages.
  • Integrated an in-mod Wiki with browser-based auto-translation support for seamless multilingual access.

Due to SPT treating any mod containing JavaScript or TypeScript files as a pre-SPT 3.11.4 mod, after extracting SptItemCreator-0.0.1+wiki_260123_12_33.7z to the game root directory, you must move the “wiki” folder out of the mod folder and into the “mods” folder for the mod to load correctly (this will trigger a “No Assemblies found in path: [game directory]\SPT\user\mods\wiki” warning, which is expected).

The contents of the wiki folder can be viewed from any location as long as they are not modified arbitrarily.

中文
  • 实现并封装了通用物品、药品、弹药、食物与饮品的创建流程。
  • 实现模组内置Wiki，支持通过浏览器自动翻译语言，便于多语言访问。

由于SPT会把所有带有任何js或ts文件的模组认为是SPT3.11.4及其之前的模组，所以SptItemCreator-0.0.1+wiki_260123_12_33.7z 压缩包解压到游戏根目录后需要把wiki移出模组文件夹，移动到mods文件夹即可正确加载模组（此时会提示No Assemblies found in path: 游戏文件夹\SPT\user\mods\wiki）

wiki文件夹的内容只要不随意更改，可以在任何位置查看
